label: Malaysia
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels in Malaysia, across Kuala Lumpur's city center and Penang's George Town and beaches.
intro: Malaysia's coverage in this directory spans Kuala Lumpur -- skyline towers near KLCC and the Petronas Towers, plus business hotels around the Golden Triangle and KL Sentral -- and Penang, where properties range from George Town's UNESCO heritage core to the Batu Ferringhi resort-beach strip on the island's north coast.
